workspace.text:

- Tuesday: 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-11:30, 11:30-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these slots and let me know which times work for all four partners. I recommend checking in this priority order: Tuesday 13:00, Wednesday 15:00, Friday 11:00, Monday 09:00, Thursday 10:00.

Once we find a time that works for all four, I'll create the booking.
